title: Plan pivot by device
statementMd:
For each plan show plays on `phone`, `web`, `speaker` and `car` as four columns.

Expected columns: `plan`, `phone`, `web`, `speaker`, `car`.

Tables: `artists`, `albums`, `tracks`, `listeners`, `plays`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT l.plan, SUM(p.device = 'phone') AS phone, SUM(p.device = 'web') AS web, SUM(p.device = 'speaker') AS speaker, SUM(p.device = 'car') AS car FROM plays p JOIN listeners l ON l.id = p.listener_id GROUP BY l.plan;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
